purpose: Classical IK plus joint-position PD circle baseline; no RL, ROS, SDK, or hardware
circle_phase_profile: one constant-omega circle bracketed by smooth velocity ramps

screening.collision_method: URDF CAD convex hull, AABB certificate with exact LP fallback

rationale.home_pose: A nonsingular, locally collision-screened configuration reached from B1-S0 q=0 by a smooth joint-space ingress
rationale.circle: The center places q_home on the circle before a smooth phase ramp; a constant-omega revolution and stop ramp follow with fixed link6 orientation
rationale.limits: Derivative and collision gates are experiment-only; they are not hardware specifications or deployment limits
